description:
Generalize the existing `intro_anomaly_log` pattern (Finding 7, `scenarios/landing-page-business-suite/api/main.go:1007-1018`) into a `payment_anomaly_log` table covering all guardrail-detected anomalies: stuck checkout sessions, missing subscriptions, repeated authorization-without-download, credit-spike anomalies, webhook processing failures.

Add a single outbound alert dispatcher that POSTs a JSON payload to a configurable webhook URL (Slack/Discord/monitoring endpoint) when a row is inserted, subject to a simple rate limiter to avoid alert storms. Expose the webhook URL, enabled flag, and per-type rate limits through the existing Stripe settings admin surface or equivalent config.

See Findings 2, 7 and round-2 d2=B decision (webhook callback delivery) of research/lpbs-payment-guardrails-and-reconciliation-plan.
name: lpbs-payment-anomaly-log-and-alerts
title: Payment anomaly log + configurable webhook alert delivery
